The repository ships **8 packages** under `packages/`. A package is a Rust crate that
adds components, systems and script commands to the engine; see
[Custom Rust Components & Packages](/guides/packages/) for how they work and how to write one.

Each page below is generated from the package itself: its registrations are read from the source,
and its prose is the package's README or crate doc.

## Built-in packages

Linked into the stock native runtime, web build and editor viewport. A project switches them with
`settings.enabled_packages`.

| Package | What it is | Script namespace | Components |
|---|---|---|---|
| [jengine-audio](/packages/audio/) | Audio package for jEngine — kira-based sound effects and music | - | 1 |
| [jengine-parallax](/packages/parallax/) | Parallax scrolling background package for jEngine — multi-layer depth-based scrolling | `Parallax` | 1 |
| [jengine-particles](/packages/particles/) | Particle system package for jEngine — 2D particle emitters and simulation | - | 1 |
| [jengine-physics](/packages/physics/) | Physics package for jEngine — rapier2d-based rigid body physics | - | 4 |
| [jengine-swarm](/packages/swarm/) | Flocking / swarm AI for jEngine - spatial-grid boids that scale to thousands of entities | - | 2 |

## Project packages

Linked only into the builds of a project that lists them in `project.jengine`'s `"packages"` array.

| Package | What it is | Script namespace | Components |
|---|---|---|---|
| [jengine-net](/packages/net/) | WebSocket transport, connection lifecycle and a script-reachable message bus | `Net` | 0 |
| [jengine-online](/packages/online/) | A game's side of jengine-server: sign in, join rooms, and show synced entities | `Online` | 2 |
| [jengine-tracker](/packages/tracker/) | Tracker music: .song files from jSuite's Music Tracker, synthesised to PCM when they load | - | 0 |
